batting.name: AC Gilchrist
batting.dismissal: c JH Kallis b A Kumble

batting.name: RG Sharma
batting.dismissal: c KP Pietersen b P Kumar

batting.name: A Symonds
batting.dismissal: c RV Uthappa b DW Steyn

batting.name: Y Venugopal Rao
batting.dismissal: c CL White b ND Doshi

batting.name: PP Ojha
batting.dismissal: c JH Kallis b A Kumble

balls.text: They're knocked out for 82, the lowest score in this IPL, a short delivery from round the wicket, pulled away straight into the hands of deep midwicket, we might be heading for an early finish
the googly, tossed up on the off, defended to extra cover
that went on straight, and was quicker through the air, Harris didn't pick it and he played across the line, missed and was trapped in front of middle
even better, timber! Another wicket-maiden, full on middle and leg, makes room to drive it through the off side, misses and leg stump is flat on the ground
bowls it full outside off, aiming for the yorker, plays it back to the bowler, another maiden?
and again, an attempted bouncer bowled at 136 kmph, swings hard at it, misses
short on the off, makes room to smote that over midwicket, misses
bowls it on a good length, driven firmly but straight to mid-off
full outside off, makes room to smash that past the bowler, misses
short on the off, turning away, makes room and punches that to extra cover
shortish on the off, turns away, slaps it back towards the bowler
gets forward and pushes it towards extra cover

Doshi gets his first IPL wicket, tossed it up and he charged out to smack him over extra cover, it turned away, he ended up miscuing it over point and Cameron White had no difficulty running back a few steps to complete the catch
pushed in the direction of cover for a single
flighted outside off, steered towards point from the crease
short of a good length on middle, worked towards square leg for a single
nips back in just a touch, gets forward and defends it cautiously back to the bowler
fullish outside off, tries to drive it through the line, gets an under-edge on the bounce to the keeper
lands on a good length, drops it into the leg side wide of midwicket for a single
short of a good length , pulled towards deep square leg for one

gets him first ball, that was too close to cut, short of a good length and skidded onto him as he tried to chop it, got a thin inside edge onto the stumps, an unglamorous but brave effort from Anirudh ends
short of a good length on the off, pushed towards extra cover
pitched up and he had eyed his spot, smacked him over mid-off for a couple of bounces over the rope
looks to late-cut him there and it's bowled at the right length, misses
short on the off, mistimes an attempted pull to long-on
shortish, pushed towards long-on for a quick single, quickly decides against the second
bowls it on a good length on middle, pushes it back to the bowler
pulled away towards deep square leg, it's uppish but lands just short of the fielder who makes a valiant attempt diving forward, that was KP Apanna the substitute
flatter and got it to turn into the left-hander, Anirudh came down the track to loft him over the leg side, was struck on the pads
that's a big one, had some air, came down the track to the pitch and smashed it over long-on cleanly
gets on the back foot, turning away and works it wide of midwicket for a single
bowled flat, swept towards deep square leg for a single
tossed up on middle and leg, gets down to slog-sweep that, is hit on the pads and it lobs up to Uthappa
awkwardly pulls it towards deep midwicket for a single
bowled on a good length on middle, swept towards square leg, calls for a single but is rightly sent back
short, makes room to cut, gets an inside edge through the keeper's leg and just past the helmet to roll down the boundary
driven down the ground to long-on for a single
takes it off a length and pushes it to extra cover
starts with a gift, short and wide, Venu makes room and cuts it uppishly through point for a boundary
flighted on middle, pushed down the ground to long-on for a single
really slow through the air, turning away a hint, drops it in front of cover
goes for the paddle, gets it behind square for just a single
down the leg side for the left-hander and spins away further, given a wide
flatter, spinning away, eased it towards cover for a single
gave it some air this time, fullish, and he defends it into the leg side
short of a good length outside off, turned away and he let it go
Kumble drops that short and is pulled towards deep backward square leg for a single
and again, makes a bit of room to cut that towards point
short of a length outside off, chops it in the direction of point
pushed off the front foot past the bowler for a single
that was the googly and he turned the face on it a little too early, not picking it, gets a leading edge through extra cover for a single
bowled it short outside off, tries to cut it through point, misses, that didn't turn
pushed towards long-on off the front foot for a single
lovely delivery, beats him again, much flatter and got it to spit away to just escape the outside edge, nice stuff from the son of Dilip
looping it on middle, fullish, plays it back down the pitch
turned away sharply, bowled on a good length on the off, drew him forward and got it to spin away to beat the outside edge
bowling it on middle and off, worked away through square leg for a single
aggression from Venugopal, almost out of nowhere, flighted and he takes up the challenge, charges down the track, gets to the pitch and smashes it over Kumble's head and over the ropes
short of a good length, got onto the back foot and pushed it it towards cover
turning away, waited for it, landed on a good length and he left it be
tossed up on middle, driven through the line to mid-on
bowled'im! Bowled from slightly wide of the crease, that was the slider, Smith played outside the line to that one, it slid in to beat him through the gate and crash into the stumps
pulled towards deep square leg for a single

appeal for obstructing the field: slower one again, pushes it back to the bowler and rushes for a single, the non-striker sends him back in time, Praveen tries to collect and throw it back onto the stumps at Smith's end but collides with Smith who turns to make it back to the crease, Praveen appears to have hurt his waist, Uthappa appealed but there was no response from the umpire, difficult to determine whether the collision was intentional
a dibbly slower legcutter, Smith had shaped himself for another attacking shot but adapted well, moving back and pushing it back to the bowler
Dwayne Smith senses a chance with that back of a length delivery outside off, swipes it through square leg for a welcome boundary
shortish on the off, punches it towards mid-off for a quick single
short on the off, swats it as Steyn runs across and cuts it off from fine leg
bowled it short on middle, pulled away towards fine leg for one more
short of a good length outside off and moves away, thinks of playing at it but withdraws at the right time, that was a wicket-maiden, a rarity this tournament
full on middle, pushes it towards mid-on from the crease
shortish again, stands tall and slaps it towards mid-off
back of a length on middle, gets back and knocks it down cautiously into the off side
pushed him back with that short of a length delivery, defended into the leg side

gone! Symonds has squandered that life given by the dropped chance, Steyn has made amends, Short of a good length on the off and moved away, Symonds, after giving himself just a hint of room, attempted a cut, got a thick edge and Uthappa took a sharp one moving to his right behind the stumps

Steyn drops one at fine leg, that was the bouncer on middle, went for the pull, got the top edge, that came onto him a little too quickly, and Steyn overran that one and it was too late before he realised
short of a good length on the off, punched towards mid-off for a single
a fraction short on middle and he seizes the length early rocking back and pulling it over square leg for a boundary
bowls it short on the off, cuts it towards third man for a single
shortish on middle, made a bit of room and cut it towards point
short of a good length on middle, made a bit of room and got back to chop it down towards point
picked the slower one there, 116.6 kmph, pushed it full on the off and Anirudh lofted him well over the in-field to find the boundary
hurled it short outside off, tries to cut that hard over point, missed, plenty of bounce there
the offcutter there, bowled at 118 kmph, gets on the back foot and chops it towards point
full outside off and he tries to blaze that through mid-off, it moves away to just escape the outside edge
held back the length again, gets back and taps it towards point
short and wide, plenty of width, slashes hard and misses, touched 140 kmph, has bowled much slower than that today
short of a good length on middle, get back and defends it solidly towards extra cover
nips in a hint and raps Symonds on the pads as he tries to play that into the leg side, would have gone high
short of a length outside off, cut hard down towards point
banged it short on the off, and he backs away from it

Rohit, not for the first time this tournament, throws away his wicket, bowled it short on middle and he tried to punch it over mid-on, mistimed and it landed safe in the hands of Pietersen, three down
bowled it short on middle, pulled away towards deep square leg for a single
slower one bowled on a good length on middle, opens the face to guide it behind point for a single
nicely done, a fraction fuller, gets forward and slices it hard over point for a boundary, raced away
short down the leg side, tries to help it on its way fine, misses, its called a wide
short of a good length outside off, bowls it at 135 kmph, cracked off the back foot to point
short of a good length and again it nips back in, punches it back to the bowler
shortish outside off, nips back in and he shoulders arms to the keeper
Steyn swings that in, lands on almost a yorker length on middle, digs it out into the off side
shortish, cuts hard at it, gets a thick edge towards third man for a single
short of a good length on leg stump, turned away behind square for a couple
appeal for lbw, rapped on the pads as he tries to work that away square, misses, is struck a little high and that appeared to be angling down the leg side
short of a good length on the off, punches it towards mid-off
teasing length outside off, a hint of away movement, shoulders arms to leave it to the keeper
another one down! Monish Mishra walks across to drive that fullish delivery through midwicket, lands on middle and he misses to be caught in plumb
tossed up on middle, gets on the front foot and drives it back to the bowler
bowled at 80 kmph, short of a length on the off, it was the googly, pushed towards point from the crease

Gilchrist falls to a trap, full toss on middle, he should have smashed that into the stands, swings it flat towards deep square leg where Kallis takes an excellent catch over his head and falls over, but just inside the ropes, Gilchrist will be feeling terrible, that ends a poor IPL for him with the bat
fullish again, flicked towards short fine leg
tossed up on middle, pushed back off the front foot to the bowler
tossed up outside off, lands full and he crunches it through the covers for a boundary, nicely timed
all over, sliding it on middle and leg, Pietersen gives him the charge and dispatches it over wide long-on for a six
comes down the track and chips it towards long-off for a single
caught the glove there as he tried to sweep it fine, lobbed up in front of the bowler but fell short
defended in front of extra cover for a quick single
drifting in on middle, pushed towards square leg
low full toss, caressed to deep cover for a single
short outside off, chops it wide of point to sneak a quick run
bowled it on a good length on the off, pushed off the front foot to mid-on
slapped hard, short outside off and he thumps that between mid-off and extra cover to the ropes
the legcutter bowled short, pulled away to deep midwicket for a single
bowls it on a good length outside off, driven hard towards extra cover
full toss, drives him just wide of long-off for a single
gets outside the line and clips it through square leg for a single
punched through the off side towards deep cover for a single
he had made his mind up there, Sharma decided to push it full and Pietersen gave him the charge and connected brilliantly, clearing long-on with ease
he's bowled too many short, that was on the off, cut away to deep point for a single
flat on the off, knocked in front of point for a quick single
picked the gap there, a fraction short, he waited, moved away and placed it perfectly through point and cover
shortish, turning away, cuts it towards point
fullish outside off, driven off the front foot towards long-off for one more
flighted outside off, makes room and chips it over point for a single
short on the off, nudged towards point and steals a quick single
flighted on the off, gets forward and defends it to cover
beaten this time as it rips away to just escape the outside edge after he comes forward to defend
held back the length there, short outside off, turning away, reaches for the cut and slashes it behind short third man
leading edge, tossed up, inviting him to play forward and across the line, it turned away and it lobbed up just wide of point for a single
short on the off, gets outside the line and tries to paddle it fine, just the single
full outside off, tries to sweep it square, misses as it turns away, Gilchrist fumbles and they pick a bye
short again, punched hard towards cover
paddles it towards fine leg for a single
pushed through midwicket for a couple of runs
guides it down towards third man for a single
shortish on middle and leg, tries to whip it through square leg, is struck on the pads
appeared to stop on him a little there, checked his shot and played it back on the pitch
pushed it a touch further, turned away and he cut it towards point
short, waiting for it to turn away and he smacks it towards deep cover for a single
Symonds at silly point has taken some hammering, short outside off and he drills it hard into Symonds' leg, just the single and he's decided not to field there anymore
gift ball first up, short outside off and he gets back to slap it past silly point and through the covers for a boundary
a tame dismissal, short on the off, spinning away and he punches it straight back to the bowler, an easy catch
short on the off, slapped towards long-on for a single
swept towards deep square leg for a single
lands full on the off, driven past the bowler who can't prevent the single
flighted on the off, pushed towards extra cover
that was struck hard, pitched up and he drove it hard at Symonds at silly point who was caught at the back
defended in the direction of silly point
fullish on the off, played in the direction of mid-on and races through for a quick single, easily done, there is a direct hit at the bowler's end but he is comfortably in
low full toss on middle, pushed towards mid-on
appeared to be the legcutter there, bowled at 128 kmph, came down the track and defended, got a thick outside edge towards the widish slip
dropped it short, tried to hook it, missed but was a touch too high and was called a wide
that was pitched up and he freed his arms, came down a couple of steps and hammered him over mid-off for a boundary
targeting middle and leg, that was bowled at 137.1 kmph, defended back towards the bowler
short on middle, pulled away towards a squarish fine leg for a single
a lowish full toss middle, played back to the bowler
pushed through with a bit of a reach towards long-off for a single
that went on straight, tried to defend it outside the line, gets an inside edge onto his pads
short and wide, makes room and cuts it away hard past a diving point for a boundary, there is a silly point in place
reaches forward and defends
short of a length outside off, goes for the cut but it turns away and he misses
short outside off, chopped it towards short third man
Kallis tried to target that third-man area as well but his execution was not up top the mark, got an under edge just behind the keeper
shortish on middle and leg, whipped towards fine leg for a single
classy, there is no third man and he picked his spot, short and wide, he made a bit of room and cut him behind point for a boundary
oooh, a chance, there is a short midwicket in place, a catcher, pushes it uppishly just wide of that fielder there, Monish Mishra's the man, he dived to his left but was unable to get his hands to it
swinging in, lands on a good length, Kallis gets outside the line and defends towards extra cover
full on middle, driven past the bowler, mid-on moves across and keeps them down to a single
bowls it on a good length on the off, pushed towards mid-off
targeting the blockhole, ends up being a low full toss, pushes it back to the bowler
trying to get him to drive at that one but he doesn't, moves away after pitching and he shoulders arms
played watchfully in the direction of mid-on
shortish on middle, gets on the back foot and dabs it back onto the pitch
short on leg stump, nudges it in front of short fine leg for a single
short of a good length on middle, pushed off the back foot to the bowler
edged and four, fullish and he tries to drive it through the covers, there is a slip in place but this evades him comfortably, four more, there is no third man
swinging in, tries to whip it through square, clips the pads and rolls down towards fine leg
short of a good length, dabbed in front of point for a quick single
lovely timing but just a single, a hint of inswing, Dravid gets on the back foot and whips it through midwicket but there is cover in the deep
short of a good length on the off, gets back, stands tall and defends it onto the pitch
shortish outside off, holds its line and he allows it through
hurling it on a good length on middle, defended solidly back to the bowler
short of a good length on the off, gets on the back foot and defends to cover
full outside off, reaches forward, opens the face and square drives it through a diving point for a boundary
fullish on middle and leg, driven wide of mid-on for a couple, Bangalore are away
